components.title: Components and versions
components.description: One per line, as name@version. Built-in products: Ollama, Open WebUI, Langflow, Flowise, LiteLLM, n8n, Dify, RAGFlow, ComfyUI, MCP Inspector (for example n8n@2.40.0 or "Open WebUI 0.11.2"). Any other package: prefix its ecosystem, for example pypi:requests@2.31.0 or npm:express@4.17.1.

useOsv.title: Also query OSV.dev
useOsv.description: Merge live results from the OSV.dev database with the curated list. Turn off to use only the curated list.

onlyAffected.title: Only save affected components
onlyAffected.description: Skip components with no known advisories in the output.
